title: 'Reject' and 'Not enough evidence' permanently brick the session with a raw state-machine error
user: learner or judge exploring the offered alternative responses at the Prediction step
devpost_criterion: Functionality / quality of the core learning loop; demo robustness in front of judges
prerequisites: Any sample session advanced to step 2 (claim submitted)
steps: Step 2: expand 'More ways to respond'
Click 'Not enough evidence' (session B: session_64faa932) or 'Reject' (session C: session_ed15dccb)
App returns to Step 1 with claim preserved and a refined hint, implying refinement is possible
Click 'Compare two explanations' again
expected: Resubmission succeeds (or the app clearly states the session is closed and offers a guided new-session path); no internal state names shown
actual: Raw banner text 'Invalid transition from INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE to BELIEF_TEST_PROPOSED' (session B) and 'Invalid transition from REJECTED_BY_LEARNER to BELIEF_TEST_PROPOSED' (session C). Repeating the click repeats the error. No in-session recovery; 'Start over' abandons the session. Revisiting the URL later shows 'Result withheld. No verified result was released... Return to the test and try again.' with no actionable element.

evidence.label: Reproduced
evidence.detail: Exact raw error strings on screen after resubmission, both variants

evidence.label: Reproduced
evidence.detail: Repeat click yields identical error (persistent brick)

evidence.label: Directly observed
evidence.detail: Stale bricked session shows 'Result withheld' dead page; Studio drawer routes to it

likely_cause: State machine records terminal learner states (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / REJECTED_BY_LEARNER) but the Question-step resubmission path attempts the BELIEF_TEST_PROPOSED transition without a permitted edge; error surfaces uncaught as raw text; UI misleadingly re-presents the Step-1 form as if refinement were possible
unverified: Whether an edited claim (vs identical text) also fails; whether live mode shares the bug
learner_impact: A learner who engages with the two most pedagogically interesting buttons loses their whole session and sees developer internals
judge_impact: A judge clicking 'Reject' during evaluation bricks the demo with a raw state error — highly visible failure of the core loop
trust_impact: Undermines 'refused, not guessed' / robustness claims; leaks internal state names
recommended_correction: Allow claim re-proposal from INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE/REJECTED_BY_LEARNER (add transitions) OR close those states explicitly: hide the resubmit form, show a human message ('This session is closed — start a new question') with a one-click new-session action; never render raw transition errors
smallest_correction: Catch the transition error client-side and replace the Step-1 form with a closed-session panel + 'Start a new question' button
acceptance_criteria: After Reject/Not-enough-evidence, resubmission either succeeds or shows a closed-session panel with a working next action; no raw state text; deep-link to the session shows the same actionable panel
regression_test: E2E: sample session → step 2 → Reject → resubmit → assert no 'Invalid transition' text and a usable path forward; same for Not enough evidence
dependencies: State machine transition table; error boundary on session view
score_leverage: Very high — removes a demo-killing crash on a judge-visible path

title: Live mode: 'Continue with my notebook' advances with zero evidence and hangs forever at 'Preparing artifact…' while /judge claims live authority is configured
reproducibility: 2/2 (also observed by swarm); readiness checks green every time
user: learner or judge attempting the advertised live notebook path
devpost_criterion: Working product / honesty of live-vs-sample claims; demo completeness
prerequisites: Visit /new (readiness checks resolve green: 'Notebook lesson tools are ready to try', 'Hosted notebook runner is ready')
steps: Click 'Continue with my notebook' without attaching a file
Question step renders with 'Preparing artifact…', SHA-256 'Pending intake', 'Support decision: Pending', metric 'Not available'
Type a claim — 'Compare two explanations' CTA never becomes enabled (observed ≥2 min across re-renders)
Navigate/scroll away: view resets to intake panel and typed claim is lost
expected: CTA blocked until an artifact is attached ('attach a notebook to continue'), or intake completes/fails with a visible error and retry; claims persist
actual: Silent indefinite hang; no error, timeout, retry, or remediation; green readiness claims contradict the dead flow; /judge simultaneously advertises 'Deployed live authority is configured' and 'Run live'

evidence.label: Reproduced
evidence.detail: 'Preparing artifact…' + 'Pending intake' persist; submit CTA absent from interactive elements

evidence.label: Directly observed
evidence.detail: /judge 'Deployed live authority is configured'; /new readiness checks green

likely_cause: No artifact-presence gate on the primary CTA; intake promise neither resolves nor rejects when no file was provided; no watchdog/timeout; readiness check measures config presence, not end-to-end liveness
unverified: Behaviour with an actual valid .ipynb upload (file input untestable via tooling)
learner_impact: The headline 'Test my notebook' journey silently dead-ends; typed work is lost
judge_impact: Judge clicking 'Run live' hits a dead flow that the dossier claims is configured — reads as misleading live-vs-sample
trust_impact: Direct contradiction between advertised capability and observed behaviour
recommended_correction: Gate the CTA on artifact presence; add intake timeout + visible error + retry; make the readiness check end-to-end (ping a real runner) or downgrade the /judge claim to 'live mode unavailable in this deployment'
smallest_correction: Disable 'Continue with my notebook' until a file is attached, and add a 30s intake timeout that surfaces an error with a 'use the sample lesson instead' escape
acceptance_criteria: Without an upload the live flow cannot be entered; with intake failure the user sees a clear message and recovery within 60s; /judge live-availability text matches reality
regression_test: E2E: /new with no file → CTA disabled; stubbed intake failure → visible error + sample escape; /judge availability text asserted against runner health endpoint
score_leverage: Very high — fixes the largest honesty gap in the submission

title: Evidence & proof drawer permanently shows '0 events' and empty tabs even after a completed verified session
reproducibility: Reproduced on completed session A (also on mid-journey sessions B–E); matches swarm V4
user: learner or judge inspecting the in-app evidence trail
devpost_criterion: Verification narrative; 'prove it like science' promise
environment: Chromium 1920x1080, sample lesson completed to proof page
prerequisites: Complete a sample session through Repair (proof page reachable)
steps: Open 'Evidence & proof' drawer (counter reads '0 events')
Click Activity tab
Click Plan tab
Click Verifier tab
expected: Drawer lists the session's events (12 exist in the signed record) and per-tab evidence
actual: Counter stays '0 events' through all 6 steps and the proof page; Activity='No activity evidence yet.', Plan='No plan evidence yet.', Verifier='No verifier evidence yet.' — directly contradicting the downloadable record

evidence.label: Reproduced
evidence.detail: Empty drawer tabs + 0 counter after completion

evidence.label: Observed in generated artifact
evidence.detail: Downloaded proof record contains 12 hash-chained events for the same session

likely_cause: Drawer wired to a client-side/live event feed that is never populated (sessions are server-rendered from stored events); counter and tabs read the empty feed
unverified: Diff/Tests tabs (same stub pattern assumed); Provenance tab reported populated by agent1
learner_impact: The flagship transparency feature looks broken/empty at the exact moment proof matters most
judge_impact: A judge opening the drawer during evaluation sees 'no evidence' — contradicts the core pitch
trust_impact: In-app display disagrees with the signed record; undermines 'evidence binding' claims
recommended_correction: Populate drawer from the same stored event stream that builds the proof record; bind counter to event count
smallest_correction: Render the session's stored events into the Activity tab and set the counter from events.length
acceptance_criteria: After any completed session, counter equals the record's event count and each tab shows its corresponding payloads
regression_test: E2E: complete sample session → open drawer → assert counter=12 and Activity lists 12 items
score_leverage: High — restores the central 'proof' differentiator in-app

title: Transfer gate: timeline ✓/× markers are inverted relative to the answer key (✓-marked option fails, ×-marked option passes)
reproducibility: Reproduced: 3 failed attempts with marked options + 2 passes (sessions A and D)
user: learner at the transfer gate; judge probing the release gate
devpost_criterion: Educational effectiveness; learnability of the transfer step
steps: Select 'Known item price' as the feature that crosses NOW — timeline draws 'uses available information ✓' next to it
Check transfer with correct split + ✓-marked feature → fails
Select 'Centered rolling target' — timeline draws 'reads later outcomes ×' — with correct split → passes
expected: Visual marks guide toward the correct answer (or are neutral); failing choices are marked wrong after feedback
actual: The ✓ mark sits on the option that cannot pass (it is the SAFE feature, but the question asks to identify the LEAKY one) and the × mark sits on the required answer; marks persist unchanged after failed attempts, so a learner following the ✓ cue fails repeatedly

evidence.label: Reproduced
evidence.detail: Attempt 2 (Time-ordered holdout + ✓ Known item price) → 'Transfer not yet passed'

evidence.label: Reproduced
evidence.detail: ×-marked Centered rolling target + holdout → 'Transfer passed · Patch unlocked' (twice)

evidence.label: Directly observed
evidence.detail: Marker semantics: ✓='uses available information', ×='reads later outcomes'

likely_cause: Timeline glyphs encode feature safety (✓ safe / × leaky) while the question's answer key requires selecting the leaky feature; the two semantics are conflated in one control
unverified: Whether failure feedback ever updates the glyphs
learner_impact: Systematically misleads learners at the exact step meant to test understanding; feedback message ('remove any feature that reads values to the right of NOW') does not say which selection was wrong
judge_impact: A judge may conclude the app marks wrong answers correct (or right answers wrong) — reads as a scoring bug even though scoring is correct
trust_impact: Perceived inverted grading at the release gate
recommended_correction: Re-label glyphs to semantics ('safe at prediction time' / 'leaks future data') instead of ✓/×, or invert the question to 'which feature is safe to use?'; after a failed attempt, mark the chosen option as incorrect
smallest_correction: Replace ✓/× glyphs with text tags 'safe'/'leaks future' and add per-option feedback after Check transfer
acceptance_criteria: No ✓/× mark appears on an option in a way that contradicts the answer key; failed attempts annotate which choice was wrong
regression_test: E2E: choose ✓-labelled-safe feature → assert failure feedback identifies the feature choice as the problem; choose leaky feature + holdout → pass
score_leverage: Medium-high — removes a confusing signal at the pedagogical climax

title: Result hash mismatch between live sample sessions and the verified replay of the same lesson
reproducibility: Observed consistently (2 live sessions vs replay page)
user: judge cross-checking the replay against a live run
prerequisites: One completed sample session + the replay page
steps: Note result hash on live sample step 4/proof page (a6ae7652e04e…, identical across two independent live sessions)
Open /replay/leakage-01 and advance to step 4 (2501654264b9…)
Compare
expected: Same replay_id → same verified result hash, or a visible explanation of versioning
actual: Hashes differ (a6ae7652e04e… vs 2501654264b9…) while the proof page simultaneously asserts replay_id=leakage-01; judge page notes the replay is a 'legacy v1' recording but the proof page does not reconcile the two hashes

evidence.label: Directly observed
evidence.detail: Live: 'result a6ae7652e04e…' (sessions A and D); Replay: 'result 2501654264b9…'

likely_cause: Replay recorded under an older kernel/verifier version ('legacy v1'); live sample recomputes under current versions; hash inputs include versioned code, so values diverge without an on-page reconciliation
unverified: Exact hash inputs (no repo access); whether any UI text reconciles the versions
judge_impact: A judge comparing the two 'verified' surfaces finds mismatched hashes for the same replay_id — looks like a proof mismatch
trust_impact: Apparent inconsistency in the integrity story
recommended_correction: Display the kernel/verifier version beside each result hash and add one line on the proof page: 'this session recomputed the leakage-01 scenario under kernel vX; replay was recorded under v1'
smallest_correction: Add version labels next to the truncated hashes on step 4, replay, and proof pages
acceptance_criteria: A judge can explain any hash difference from information on the page
regression_test: Snapshot test asserting version label presence wherever a result hash renders

title: Home 'Test this claim' accepts any text (including gibberish/off-topic) and routes it into the dead live flow; drafts are silently lost
reproducibility: Reproduced for malformed input; routing inconsistency observed once (A4-09)
user: first-time learner typing a question on the landing page
devpost_criterion: First-run experience; 'unsupported evidence is refused, not guessed' claim
steps: Type 'asdf ### ???' (or any text) in home textarea
Click 'Test this claim →'
Land on /new device-check page with no reference to the claim
Only working path is 'Use the sample lesson' (claim carried once, lost once)
expected: Either the claim drives a real (working) flow, or the app states up front that text-only claims cannot be tested live and offers the sample explicitly; drafts persist
actual: All text is accepted with zero validation and routed to the broken live flow; the user's words may be silently discarded; gibberish claims proceed through the sample lesson as if meaningful

evidence.label: Reproduced
evidence.detail: 'asdf ### ???' accepted verbatim into a sample session, displayed as the claim at step 2

evidence.label: Directly observed
evidence.detail: Home submit routes to /new (live) for text-only claims

likely_cause: Home entry is a thin funnel into /new; no claim-level validation or routing to sample; draft state held in volatile view state
unverified: Off-topic claim ('Why is the sky blue?') end-to-end (inferred identical to J08)
learner_impact: First-run users type their real question and hit a dead end or lose their text
judge_impact: The most natural judge interaction (type a claim on the landing page) leads to the broken live flow
trust_impact: Contradicts 'refused, not guessed' — nothing is refused at the front door
recommended_correction: Route text-only claims to the sample lesson explicitly ('try the mechanics on our sample notebook') with the claim attached, or show 'live testing requires a supported notebook' before submit; persist drafts
smallest_correction: On home submit without attachment, label the /new page 'Live testing needs a notebook — or continue with the sample' and carry the claim through reliably
acceptance_criteria: No text-only submission dead-ends; claim text survives the whole funnel; unsupported inputs get a visible message
regression_test: E2E: submit text-only claim → assert either working sample session with claim intact or explicit requirement message
score_leverage: High — fixes the very first interaction

title: Bricked-session page offers no working recovery ('Return to the test and try again' points nowhere)
reproducibility: 2/2 bricked sessions (B, C), via direct URL and Studio drawer
user: learner returning to a closed session
steps: Revisit the bricked session URL (or open it from Studio drawer)
Read the page
expected: Clear closed-session explanation + one-click 'Start a new question'
actual: 'Result withheld. No verified result was released. CounterLab will not substitute bundled sample evidence for this session. Return to the test and try again.' — but no test view, form, or button exists on the page; only 'Start over' (home) works. The instruction is unactionable

evidence.label: Reproduced
evidence.detail: Dead page on both bricked sessions

likely_cause: Generic fallback renderer for terminal states with copy written for a mid-flow failure; no recovery CTA
learner_impact: Confusing dead end after losing a session
judge_impact: Judge revisiting a failed demo session finds an unactionable page
trust_impact: Error copy promises a path that does not exist
recommended_correction: Replace copy with an honest closed-session message and a 'Start a new question' button; deep-link the button to /
smallest_correction: Add a 'Start a new question' CTA on the withheld-result page and remove 'Return to the test'
acceptance_criteria: Every terminal session page offers a working next action
regression_test: E2E: brick a session → reload → assert a working 'new question' CTA and no 'return to the test' copy

title: Studio drawer history: stale status labels, indistinguishable entries, 3-entry cap
steps: Open drawer
Inspect 'Recent sessions'
Click the entry labelled 'BELIEF TEST PROPOSED'
expected: Accurate per-session status (e.g. 'Closed — rejected'), distinguishing metadata (time/claim), all sessions listed
actual: The Reject-bricked session is labelled 'BELIEF TEST PROPOSED' (its state before rejection) yet opens a dead 'Result withheld' page; every entry is named 'customer_churn_leakage.ipynb' with no timestamp/claim; list caps at 3 (an older completed session is unreachable from the drawer)

evidence.label: Directly observed
evidence.detail: Labels REASONING DIFF ISSUED / BELIEF TEST PROPOSED / INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE for sessions D/C/B respectively; C's label contradicts its dead page

likely_cause: Label derived from last successful event rather than current state; fixed 3-item window; filename used as the only identifier
learner_impact: Cannot tell projects apart; is led into dead sessions
recommended_correction: Label from current state, show claim snippet + relative time, paginate the list, mark closed sessions
smallest_correction: Use current state for the label and append a short session id/time to each row
acceptance_criteria: Drawer statuses match the destination page state for every entry
regression_test: E2E: brick a session → open drawer → assert its label indicates closure

title: Inconsistent routing: 'Use the sample lesson' once entered the live 'Preparing artifact…' flow and discarded the claim
user: learner choosing the sample escape from the live page
prerequisites: Arrive at /new with a typed claim from home
steps: Click 'Use the sample lesson'
expected: Always creates an 'Instant sample' session with the claim attached
actual: Once (of three tries) the page entered 'Live generation / Preparing artifact…' with 0 characters (claim discarded); two other times it correctly created an Instant sample session with the claim

evidence.label: Unverified
evidence.detail: Single observation; could be a race or a mis-rendered click target
evidence.ref: observed at audit step ~132 (no screenshot of the transitional click)

likely_cause: Possible race between mode selection and artifact intake, or click landing on the adjacent live CTA during re-render
learner_impact: Occasionally dead-ends the sample escape and loses typed work
judge_impact: Low unless it fires during a demo
recommended_correction: Make mode selection explicit and atomic; disable CTAs during transitions
smallest_correction: Disable all three CTAs while any navigation/intake is in flight
acceptance_criteria: 100% of 'Use the sample lesson' clicks create Instant sample sessions with the claim preserved
regression_test: E2E loop: 20 clicks of the sample CTA from /new → assert sample mode every time

title: Oversized input limits unverifiable; no stated maximum length for claims
reproducibility: Partial (inputs >~1800 chars not injectable by tooling)
steps: Enter 536-char claim (accepted, live counter, no warning)
Attempt ~5000-char input (blocked by tooling, not by the app)
expected: A visible max length or graceful truncation behaviour
actual: No stated cap; moderate lengths accepted verbatim end-to-end (appear on the proof page); true oversized behaviour unknown

evidence.label: Directly observed
evidence.detail: 536-char claim accepted and rendered in full on proof page

likely_cause: No maxlength policy on claim fields
unverified: Behaviour at very large payloads (server limits)
learner_impact: Possible silent failure or layout break with very long claims
recommended_correction: Set and display a max length (e.g. 500 chars) with counter turn-warn states
smallest_correction: Add maxlength + counter limit to the two claim textareas
acceptance_criteria: Over-limit input is prevented or visibly truncated with a message
regression_test: E2E: paste 10k chars → assert cap behaviour
